features.title: Cars follow traffic: signals, stop signs, all-way stops and give-way, from one junction analysis
features.user_visible_behavior: Signalled junctions cycle (the lit lens is the one the traffic obeys); cars stop at the line on red, come to a full stop at stop signs and take turns at all-way stops, give way to the main road, slow for corners, never block a junction; stop and give-way signs stand at every controlled arm; mapped OSM control wins, the rule of the road fills the rest. Cars wait behind the crosswalk for anyone crossing their street or the one they turn into; left turns yield to oncoming traffic at lights too; lanes zip at merges; no two cars ever share a spot.
